title: Glow Pikmin Allays
description: This is a resource pack that turns allays into Glow Pikmin from Pikmin 4. This pack is (obviously) not affiliated with Nintendo in any way. Requires Optifine to function.
body:
This is a resource pack that makes the allays look like the Glow Pikmin from Nintendo's 2023 game Pikmin 4. This pack requires Optifine to function properly. 


This pack is not affiliated with Nintendo in anyway.
